about_the_game:
In this space-vampire management RPG game, each turn intergalactic petitioners from across your realm arrive in your darkened throne room, seeking counsel. Choose wisely: will you aid them, or conserve your precious resources for grander schemes? Keep in mind: supplies are scarce, and not every visitor has the empire’s best interests at heart… Will you secure your reign or succumb to the shadows?

  • Throne-room: Hear your citizens petitions, make choices and live with the consequences.

  • Heirs: Navigate eleven rival bloodlines plotting to become the next Emperor.

  • Stewards: Balance blood, gold, military, and farmers as each resource steward claims theirs matters most.

  • Void: Deploy ships and troops to loot, board enemy ships and claim spoils.

  • Bloodline: Choose your starting family, or play as a lone wolf.

  • Unique Assets: Collect artifacts, wonders, legendary people, and powerful military to twist wars and alliances.

content_descriptors.notes:
Set in a dark and immersive Space Vampire environment, players assume the role of a Vampire Sovereign controlling a realm of other vampires. The game contains several mature themes that players should be aware of:

Violence:
Blood and Gore: The game features frequent depictions of blood, as the narrative revolves around vampire lore. Players will encounter scenes involving blood and may participate in choices that can be graphic in nature.

Execution of Criminals: Players may decide the fates of captured criminals, which involves executing them in various scenarios. These scenes may contain both strategic violence and darker themes that could be unsettling to some.

Themes of Power and Control
Hierarchical Dynamics: The storyline delves into themes of power, dominance, and submission among vampires. As a Vampire Lord, players have control over others, and decisions can lead to morally ambiguous outcomes.

Sensitive Topics:

Exploitation: The narrative may touch on elements of exploitation and betrayal. Relationships between characters can be complicated and may include manipulation or coercive behavior.

Dark Humor: Some content may contain dark humor related to the macabre aspects of the vampire lifestyle, which can be off-putting to certain players.
Additional Content Warnings

Mental Health Implications: The themes in the game may resonate with players who have experienced issues related to self-harm or mental health challenges, as the story explores the darker sides of power and existence.
